  - Structured output/tool-calling support for the reranker pipeline
  - Embedding batch sizing and reranker latency SLOs
- Next steps:

- Happy path generation works fine for small test prompts.
- When we run embeddings batches (size ~64) or call structured-output endpoints with our long payloads, we're seeing intermittent 5xx responses from the Redwood API; request_id header is present in some failures.
- ProdOps (cc'ed) will share logs and the failing request_ids. We're blocked on the reranker smoke until we can hit stable responses.

Hi Sara — thanks for the details and for looping ProdOps in.

Can you do me a favor and paste one failing request payload (sanitized) + the exact request headers and the timestamp? That will let me correlate with our ingress logs. If you prefer, attach a small request_logs.txt file.

Quick guidance while we wait:
- Try reducing the embeddings batch to 16 as a quick mitigation.
- Add a 60s request timeout in the SDK call (we've seen retries amplify backend saturation).

Minimal Node snippet (replace KEY):

const Redwood = require('@redwood/inference-sdk');
const client = new Redwood.Client({ apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_KEY });

async function callEmbeddings(batch) {
  return await client.embeddings.create({
    model: 'redwood-embed-1',
    input: batch,
    timeout: 60000 // ms
  });
}

Thanks for the logs — very helpful. I correlated req_6f8a2e4b with our ingress and saw a spike in request payload size + a proxy 502 on one of our routing nodes. A few immediate suggestions/workarounds while we investigate:

1) Reduce embedding batch to 16 (or slice larger batches client-side)
2) Set a higher client timeout for these long payloads (90s)
3) Enable simple retry with exponential backoff and jitter (max 2 retries)

I'm attaching a quick SDK snippet that sets timeout + retry logic. Also, can you re-run the failing request with an added header X-Request-Timeout: 90000 for debugging? That will show up in our traces.

If you can join a short debug call, we'll live-tail the traces and do a request from your environment so we can see the full path.

Attachment: sdk-snippet.js

— Dev

Date: Sun, 15 Mar 2026 16:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: FinLytics - 5xx root cause and temporary mitigation

Update for the thread —

Root cause: we identified a routing edge-case in our proxy that mishandles large structured-output/payload requests (>128KB) when a tool-calling header is present. That causes a 502/5xx upstream from the routing layer. We've created INF-5421 and are rolling a patch to the affected pool.

Temporary mitigation for FinLytics (apply immediately):
- Reduce embeddings batch to <= 16 (client-side slicing)
- Set request timeout to 90s (X-Request-Timeout: 90000 or SDK timeout)
- Keep retry to 2 attempts with exponential backoff

We expect the patch to be deployed to the affected nodes within 24 hours. I'll update this thread when the fix is live. In the meantime, I'm attaching the trimmed request logs we used to debug.

Attachments: request_logs_20260314.txt

Thanks —
Dev Patel
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
